create_UIOverlay: create a UIOverlay instance with an AppService and user index to manage overlay GUI canvases
update_UIOverlay_update: call update on UIOverlay to check button presses and invoke registered callbacks for the user
update_UIOverlay_reset: call reset on UIOverlay to clear all canvases and registered button callbacks for the user
update_UIOverlay_instructions_panel: call update_instructions_panel on UIOverlay to display task instructions and warning text in the top left canvas
update_UIOverlay_controls_panel: call update_controls_panel on UIOverlay to display a list of controls or a show help option in the top right canvas
update_UIOverlay_hovered_object_info: call update_hovered_object_info_panel on UIOverlay to display category name, room, and states for the hovered object
update_UIOverlay_selected_object_panel: call update_selected_object_panel on UIOverlay to display editable toggle controls for the selected object states
create_ObjectStateControl: create an ObjectStateControl dataclass with spec, value, enabled, available, callback, tooltip, and recently_changed fields
use_UIOverlay_title_str: call the static _title_str method on UIOverlay to convert snake_case strings to Title Case
